title: test_librarian_trees writes only run-marked rows to the live cairn tables and removes them, so two concurrent runs both stay green
intention: test_librarian_trees.py mints every node under a per-run id marked as testing, and removes that run's nodes, embeddings and links in a finally block, so two copies at once do not collide.
why: Measured 2026-11-19: 2026-11-19 on akiendell (Windows): alone, 10 of 10 runs green (76-102 s); inside aa750de17382's moved-proofs tooth 1 red of 4 (the first; teeth e_blocks_unearned_consolidated_sources and the consolidation-links tooth) then 3 green; Linux (akienasus_cc_0) 40 of 40 green. Two copies at once, 3 rounds: RED 6 of 6 copies (1-2 teeth each): e_blocks_unearned_consolidated_sources x3, test_source_nodes_in_provenance x3, UniqueViolation cairn_nodes_pkey, UniqueViolation cairn_embeddings_pkey. The proof writes dbname cairn at 127.0.0.1:5432 (store.DB_NAME), this box's own live PostgreSQL 17.9 (x86_64-windows), through trees.NODES_TABLE, EMBEDDINGS_TABLE and LINKS_TABLE; node ids are sha256(content)[:16], so identical fixture content from two runs is the same row. _cleanup (line 329) deletes this run's links only. Observed after the runs, not attributed and not to be deleted here: cairn_nodes 521, cairn_embeddings 476, cairn_links 9, oldest node 2026-10-28. Other proofs whose source holds the 'alpha'/'phantom' strings seen in those rows (unmarked as far as this grep shows; each gets its own ticket): cairn/devices/codemother/machines/{constrain,decompose,hypothesize,survey,triage,validate}/proofs/test_chart_*.py and cairn/devices/codemother/proofs/test_deposit.py. Law 7: a proof that writes live tables unmarked leaves rows in a record of truth and reds under concurrency.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: 6 of 6 concurrent copies red); Law 9 (green is earned: a proof that passes alone and reds beside itself has not earned it).
how: A hypothesis, not a settled shape: test live but marked as testing. In cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py a run id (token_hex, or CAIRN_LIBRARIAN_TRIALS_RUN_ID when set) is folded into every fixture's content, so node_id_for(content) is unique per run, and into each row's provenance as a testing marker; a finally block removes this run's nodes, embeddings and links (extending _cleanup, which today removes links only). A scratch table set was weighed and set aside: it would stop the proof measuring the live schema. The new proof cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees_runs_alongside_itself.py runs two copies of the librarian proof at once and counts rows before and after; it declares PROOF_TIMEOUT_S above the two-copy wall.

clauses.claim: two copies of test_librarian_trees.py run at the same time, both exit 0 with no FAIL tooth
after a run, no row carrying that run's id remains in cairn_nodes, cairn_embeddings or cairn_links, and the three tables' counts equal their counts before the run
one copy of test_librarian_trees.py run alone still exits 0

decisions.text: D1: the librarian proof folds a per-run id and a testing marker into every row it writes and removes this run's nodes, embeddings and links in a finally block.
D2: the red-first proof runs two copies at once and counts rows before and after, one tooth per clause.

out: the 521/476/9 rows already in the tables (not deleted or attributed here)
the codemother chart proofs and test_deposit.py (their own tickets)
